errors.text: The proposed intervention is severe plastic deformation by HPT/ECAP rather than static HPHT treatment in a hexahedron-anvil apparatus.
The proposed 600–800 °C processing window is far below the target 1473 K condition and omits the required 2-hour hold and cooling/decompression sequence.
The HIP experiment does not include a matched HPHT arm, so it cannot isolate extreme pressure from temperature, time, or deformation history.
The stated falsification rule is logically reversed: failure of HIP to produce the patterned structure would support, not falsify, the claim that extreme-pressure processing is required.
The baseline relies on ductile AlCoCrFeNi2.1 data rather than the strong-yet-brittle homogenized Al0.7CoCrFeNi target, undermining the claimed ductility improvement.
